offers_products.reason: Documentary streaming subscriptions, Smart Bundle, and original content libraries are the main offerings, delivered as a digital product.

offers_services.reason: It sells streaming content access, not work done for customers; subscription is a digital media product.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals and families subscribe to stream documentaries, Kidstream and cooking content on their devices.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Licenses content to media companies and distributors, and bundles through partners, though secondary to consumer subscriptions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly and annual streaming subscriptions, including the Smart Bundle, drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary entertainment subscriptions can be cancelled in a click with no contract when budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced monthly or annual streaming subscriptions are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for a streaming library and platform technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual subscribers to the documentary streaming service; some licensing to media companies is secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Streaming subscription service and content licensing; no plants or fleets, mainly content library and software platform.

notes: Licensing of content to other media companies exists but the consumer subscription is the larger part.
